snippet.title: Death at Fleming Manor – Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
[Forensic Mystery Game] Death at Fleming Manor – Coming Soon on Steam!
Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3758950/Death_at_Fleming_Manor/

"Your job is to write the death certificate."
An adventure mystery game set in a 1959 British manor. Investigate bizarre scenes and uncover the truth through forensic reports.
